title: Polynomial target evaluation of the presentation-pair derived colimit
statement:
Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, let $E$ be a set, and put $C=B[E]$, the polynomial $B$-algebra on $E$. Choose a common infinite cardinal bound containing these rings and variable sets and small representatives as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal P$ be the opposite of the category of compatible diagrams $A\to P\to Q\to C$, $P\to B\to C$, where $P$ is polynomial over $A$ and $Q$ is polynomial over $P$; morphisms before taking opposites are commuting pairs of $A$-algebra maps on $P,Q$ preserving both augmentations. Let $\mathcal D$ be the opposite category of polynomial $B$-algebras $T$ with a $B$-algebra augmentation $T\to C$, with augmentation-preserving $B$-algebra maps before taking opposites. Give both the topology generated by singleton identity coverings [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Define $v:\mathcal P\to\mathcal D$ by $v(P,Q)=(Q\otimes_P B\to C)$. For any commutative ring $R$ and any $R$-module presheaf $F$ on $\mathcal D$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let $L\pi_{\mathcal P,!}^R$ and $L\pi_{\mathcal D,!}^R$ be the derived colimits represented by [lem-trf-derived-colimit-bar]. The canonical augmentation
$$L\pi_{\mathcal P,!}^R(v^{-1}F)\longrightarrow F(C\xrightarrow{\mathrm{id}}C)[0]$$
is an isomorphism in $D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. It is the composite of the canonical reindexing map to $L\pi_{\mathcal D,!}^R F$ and the augmentation induced by the arrows $(C\xrightarrow{\mathrm{id}}C)\to(T\to C)$ in $\mathcal D$.

proof.text: Choose the standard polynomial resolution $P_\bullet\to B$ from [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence], within the fixed infinite bound: its generators are obtained by iterating the free-algebra/underlying-set construction, which stays within that bound. Every augmentation $P_n\to B$ is surjective and $s(P_\bullet)\to B[0]$ is a quasi-isomorphism. Apply [lem-trf-polynomial-resolution-extension-trivial-kan] to obtain the trivial Kan fibrations for both $P_\bullet\to B$ and $P_\bullet[E]\to B[E]$.

source.place: Tag 08QV (lemma-polynomial-on-top); Tags 08QI and 08P1, resolution and polynomial extension.

proof.text: Write $\mathcal A=\mathcal P^{op}$ and $\mathcal B=\mathcal D^{op}$. Apply [lem-trf-polynomial-pair-resolution-contractibility] to this resolution, using both trivial Kan fibrations from Step 1. It supplies $U_n=(P_n,P_n[E])$ in $\mathcal A$, the homotopy equivalence $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(W,U_\bullet)\simeq *$ for every $W$, and the canonical simplicial identification $v^{op}U_\bullet\cong\operatorname{const} C$.

source.place: Tag 08QV (lemma-polynomial-on-top); Representable fibres and base change of U; Tag 08NS.

proof.text: The bar theorem represents the required derived colimits on $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$; use the natural sign isomorphisms of [lem-trf-terminal-bar-evaluation-compatibility] to compare with the simplicial-computation convention. In $\mathcal B$, the identity-augmented $C$ is terminal: an augmentation-preserving $B$-algebra map $(T\to C)\to(C\xrightarrow{1}C)$ must equal the augmentation. Thus the constant $C$ has singleton representable mapping sets. The simplicial derived-colimit computation applied to $U_\bullet$ and to $\operatorname{const} C$ gives isomorphisms $a_U:s(\operatorname{const}F(C))\to L\pi_{\mathcal P,!}^R(v^{-1}F)$ and $a_C:s(\operatorname{const}F(C))\to L\pi_{\mathcal D,!}^RF$. Identify the coefficient complexes by Step 2's simplicial isomorphism fixing coefficients and variables. For the canonical reindexing $c=\mathbf H(v^{op},1)$, naturality gives $c\,a_U=a_C$ after that coefficient identification. The bar and sign compatibilities identify $c$ with the stated canonical reindexing map; hence $c$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 08QV (lemma-polynomial-on-top); sites-cohomology.tex Tags 08PG, 08PH and 08Q9, with the explicit bar-convention identification and canonical augmentation.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-terminal-bar-evaluation-compatibility] to $\mathcal B$, its terminal object $C$, and the covariant coefficient functor corresponding to $F$. It makes the generator-defined augmentation $\epsilon_{\mathcal D}:L\pi_{\mathcal D,!}^RF\to F(C)[0]$ an isomorphism. Its reindexing identity says that $\epsilon_{\mathcal D}c$ has degree-zero formula $(W,x)\mapsto F(C\to vW)(x)$ and all other components zero, exactly the requested augmentation. The sign comparison is the identity in degree zero, so preserves this equality. The required map is therefore the stated composite of two isomorphisms.

lean.statement: theorem polynomial_top_evaluation (I A B R : Type u) [Infinite I] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [CommRing R] (_boundA : Nonempty (A ↪ I)) (_boundB : Nonempty (B ↪ I)) (E : Set I) (system : CategoryColimitBarSystem.{u}) (F : (Target I B E)ᵒᵖᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} R) : ∃ (εD : (system.models (Target I B E)ᵒᵖ R).bar.obj F ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj (F.obj (op (op (topTarget I B E))))) (εP : (system.models (Pair I A B E)ᵒᵖ R).bar.obj ((baseChange I A B E).op.op ⋙ F) ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj (F.obj (op (op (topTarget I B E))))), IsEvaluationAugmentation (system.models (Target I B E)ᵒᵖ R) F (F.obj (op (op (topTarget I B E)))) (fun T ↦ F.map (toTop I B E T.unop).op.op) εD ∧ IsEvaluationAugmentation (system.models (Pair I A B E)ᵒᵖ R) ((baseChange I A B E).op.op ⋙ F) (F.obj (op (op (topTarget I B E)))) (fun W ↦ F.map (toTop I B E W.unop.target).op.op) εP ∧ εP = system.map (baseChange I A B E).op (RingHom.id R) (𝟙 ((baseChange I A B E).op.op ⋙ F)) ≫ εD ∧ IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map εP)
lean.note: The theorem uses the canonical bar models of lem-trf-derived-colimit-bar. Its existential augmentations are uniquely specified by all generator formulas and all nonzero-degree components, with the chain-level reindexing factorization and derived IsIso conclusion. No object is selected from a mere existence theorem.

reviewed_lean.note: Clause-by-clause check of polynomial_top_evaluation against the node and Stacks 08QU/08QV, 08PH, 08Q9. Target is the augmented polynomial B-algebras, topTarget=(E,X) is terminal before opposites, v=Q⊗_P B=B[T], and v^{-1}F is precomposition. Edge cases (E empty, empty S/T, infinite sets, B=0, R=0, F=0, non-surjective A→B) are all allowed.
